question: The value of frac{{sin 4theta }}{{( {1 - cos 4theta } )}} is:
solution:
**Given:**

(sin4theta)/((1-cos4theta))

**Formula Used:**

sin2theta = 2 sintheta costheta

cos2theta = 2cos²theta – 1 or 1 – 2sin²theta

**Calculation:**

sin4theta=sin2(2theta)

⇒ sin4theta=2sin2theta cos2theta=2(2sintheta costheta)(1-2sin²theta)

⇒ sin4theta=4sintheta costheta(1-2sin²theta)

⇒ cos4theta= 2cos²2theta-1

⇒ cos4theta=2(1-2sin²theta)²-1

⇒ Putting the values, we get

⇒ (sin4theta)/((1-cos4theta))=(4sintheta costheta(1-2sin²theta))/(1-(2(1-2sin²theta)²-1))=(4sintheta costheta(1-2sin²theta))/(1-(2[1+4sin⁴theta-4sin²theta]-1))

⇒ (sin4theta)/((1-cos4theta))=(4sintheta costheta(1-2sin²theta))/(1-1-8sin⁴theta+8sin²theta)

⇒ (sin4theta)/((1-cos4theta))=(4sintheta costheta(1-2sin²theta))/(8sin²theta(1-sin²theta))=(4sintheta costheta(1-2sin²theta))/(8sin²theta cos²theta)

⇒ (sin4theta)/((1-cos4theta))=(1-2sin²theta)/(2sintheta costheta)=(cos2theta)/(sin2theta)

⇒ (sin4theta)/((1-cos4theta))=cot2theta

**∴ the required value of the given expression is cot2theta**.
